guests_has_contact.name: guests_has_contact
guests_has_contact.value: "guests"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "guests"."phone" IS NOT NULL OR "guests"."anonymized_at" IS NOT NULL

promo_codes_value.name: promo_codes_value
promo_codes_value.value: ("promo_codes"."kind" = 'percent' AND "promo_codes"."value_bp" BETWEEN 1 AND 9000 AND "promo_codes"."amount" IS NULL) OR ("promo_codes"."kind" = 'amount' AND "promo_codes"."amount" > 0 AND "promo_codes"."value_bp" IS NULL)

promo_codes_book_window.name: promo_codes_book_window
promo_codes_book_window.value: "promo_codes"."book_from" IS NULL OR "promo_codes"."book_until" IS NULL OR "promo_codes"."book_until" >= "promo_codes"."book_from"

promo_codes_stay_window.name: promo_codes_stay_window
promo_codes_stay_window.value: "promo_codes"."stay_from" IS NULL OR "promo_codes"."stay_until" IS NULL OR "promo_codes"."stay_until" >= "promo_codes"."stay_from"

properties_early_bird_range.name: properties_early_bird_range
properties_early_bird_range.value: "properties"."early_bird_days" IS NULL OR ("properties"."early_bird_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 365 AND "properties"."early_bird_bp" BETWEEN 1 AND 9000)

recurring_expenses_months.name: recurring_expenses_months
recurring_expenses_months.value: extract(day from "recurring_expenses"."start_month") = 1 AND ("recurring_expenses"."end_month" IS NULL OR (extract(day from "recurring_expenses"."end_month") = 1 AND "recurring_expenses"."end_month" >= "recurring_expenses"."start_month"))
